paragraphs.text: Professors Adrix and Nev are merfolk teachers at the Quandrix College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . After the New Phyrexian Invasion , Adrix would become the Dean of Theory of the college and Nev the Dean of Substance.

Adrix and Nev grew up amid the mana-rich waters of the Pinzari Isles . From a very early age, the twins saw patterns in the tides and currents that eluded even the most esteemed scholars of their society. Once, they saved a hundred lives by predicting a sudden arrival of a tsunami that came out of nowhere.

They received special permission to teach together at Strixhaven , blending the mastery of Blue and Green mana. They still constantly debate among themselves about various esoteric mathematical principles. At their core, they really care about their students. If any student is in danger, they will leap into action in perfect harmony.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , most Strixhaven teachers were killed, including both deans of Quandrix College. Afterwards, Adrix and Nev were both promoted to roles as deans, with Adrix taking Imbraham 's seat as the Dean of Theory, and Nev taking Kianne 's role as Dean of Substance, respectively.
